description: Inventaire dynamique des réseaux de chaleur en région Centre-Val de Loire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ADEME. The principle of inventories is often static. The idea of this ‘dynamic’ inventory is to identify heat networks that have the potential to distribute more renewable or recovered energy than they do today. 220 heat networks are identified on the map of the Centre-Val de Loire region. Coverage: ADEME. The portal shows the English title as "Dynamic inventory of heat networks in the Centre-Val de Loire region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ADEME. The listing shows 3 download or service links in URL, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
